'''Alistair McGregor''' was the Solaran leader associated with the [[Solaran-Khalindarian Conference of 1940]]. He represented Solara during negotiations that secured Khalindar's support against the [[Vesperan Empire]].

== Conference Role ==

McGregor's role was to bring Khalindar into the anti-Vesperan war effort without allowing Khalindarian ambitions to dominate Solaran strategy. The conference offered Khalindar territorial, economic, infrastructure, and military incentives in return for wartime commitment.

== Legacy ==

McGregor's wartime diplomacy helped Solara during the [[Avant Great War]], but the unresolved promises made at Congrave later became central to the [[Khalindarian reparations dispute]].

Old source material inconsistently describes McGregor's exact office. This draft treats him as the Solaran leader at the conference until the office title is confirmed.
